models.name: stations
models.description: Each record represents a bike share station.

columns.name: city
columns.description: City where the station is located.

columns.name: num_borrowed_bike
columns.description: Number of bikes borrowed from the station, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: date_most_bikes_available
columns.description: Date when the station had the most bikes available, with ties broken by the ascending order of the date.

columns.name: above_avg_duration_trips
columns.description: Set to 1 if the average duration of trips starting from the station is above the overall average trip duration; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: per_subscriber
columns.description: Percentage of trips starting from the station that are made by subscribers.

columns.name: diff_bewteen_as_start_station_and_as_end_station
columns.description: Difference between the number of trips starting from the station and the number of trips ending at the station.
